description: Maintains persistent project goals, implementation status, architectural decisions, technical constraints, known issues, and roadmaps.

projectInfo.name: project-wish
projectInfo.displayName: A Journey of Love — From a Seed to a New Beginning

projectGoals: Deliver a 60 FPS procedural HTML5 Canvas 16-stage interactive narrative
Provide zero-dependency Web Audio API sound synthesis
Prevent agent context rot using MemoryOS 6-layer self-healing memory architecture
Support personalized wish release physics and interactive love letter composition

architecturalDecisions.title: Procedural Web Audio API Synthesis
architecturalDecisions.decision: Synthesize all soundscapes procedurally using browser AudioContext without external audio files.

architecturalDecisions.title: Dual Canvas 2D and React DOM Pipeline
architecturalDecisions.decision: Use Canvas 2D for high-density particle physics and tree growth; use React DOM for interactive forms and modals.

architecturalDecisions.title: MemoryOS Self-Healing Integration
architecturalDecisions.decision: Implement mathematical drift detection (drift = 1 - cosine_similarity) with auto-heal trigger at theta = 0.45.

knownProblems: Web Audio context requires user interaction before unmuting due to browser autoplay policy.
Retina canvas scaling requires synchronization with window.devicePixelRatio on resize.
Long multi-turn AI narrative sessions risk context rot without periodic MemoryOS healing.
todos: Wire WishSection form to backend LangGraph agent endpoint
Connect LoveLetter component to streaming model provider SSE stream
Implement real-time multi-agent sync bus over Redis

changelog.notes: Added complete MemoryOS 6-layer memory architecture and documentation suite.
Added interactive wish application components and story context (commit 1f6d137).
Cinematic experience, HUD controls, navigation, and procedural Web Audio engine.
